A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FinPercep-RM, FGR-30k and CCL work. All 11 pages, including equations, four figures and four tables, are readable and matchable. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix; both end with references.

before.justification: Tables 1–4 report original super-resolution benchmark results, human preference outcomes, RLHF strategy comparisons and component ablations.

after.justification: Tables 1–4 retain the original benchmark, user-study, RLHF strategy and ablation results. These remain original empirical outcomes.

M1.justification: The encoder-decoder, feature/map fusion, three training losses and staged CCL procedure are retained. The revised overview, equation symbols and Figure 2 clarify the existing design without establishing a changed algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions use FGR-30k and evaluate real-world super-resolution on DrealSR, RealSR, RealLR200 and RealLQ250. Added restoration citations do not introduce evaluated datasets or tasks.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains ResShift, SUPIR, DreamClear and the baseline, CLIP-IQA-guided and proposed variants of DiffBIR, SeeSR and DiT4SR. The user-study, RLHF-strategy and ablation comparator sets also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported 4x upscaling setting, DiT4SR-derived training/validation protocol, LPIPS and four no-reference metrics, and REFL/DPO/GRPO evaluation procedures remain unchanged. No revised splits, budgets or testing procedures are reported.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 and Table 4 retain the same tests of feature-level supervision, coupled reward estimation, removal of CCL and parameter growth versus loss-weight scheduling. The training curves and qualitative comparisons add no new analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions retain point estimates and user preference percentages without reported repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or formal significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All 258 numerical entries in Tables 1–4 are identical, including DiT4SR w/Ours RealLQ250 MUSIQ 73.456 and MANIQA 0.658. Figures 1 and 4 retain their findings. Figure 2 changes illustrative reward numbers in the pipeline schematic, rather than measured experimental results.

T1.justification: Equations 2, 6 and 7 standardize existing notation: M_pdm becomes M_fg-pdm, the synthetic-image score is written S_syn, and S(I_GT) becomes S_GT. The underlying definitions and losses remain equivalent; no assumptions, derivations or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The rewritten abstract preserves the claims that FinPercep-RM addresses local reward hacking, FGR-30k supplies diagnostic supervision, and CCL stabilizes training. The introduction's contribution list and conclusion retain the same scientific scope.

C2.justification: The explanations of reward hacking, the stability–robustness tradeoff and the ablation findings remain unchanged. The overview's feature-fusion clarification matches the architecture already described in v1; no new limitations or applicability boundaries appear.

D1.justification: The v2 abstract adds a GitHub release address and states that code will be available. This supplies new access information, without establishing that code has been released. Figure 2 also corrects its frozen/trainable legend; no new hyperparameter, hardware or runtime details are supplied.

R1.justification: Nine background references are added, including FM2S, DreamUHD and DDSR-Net, while Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers is removed as Section 2.1 is condensed. The broader restoration context changes locally; central novelty positioning remains stable. Duplicate SUPIR and LPIPS references are consolidated.

P1.justification: The abstract, parts of Section 2.1 and the method overview are rewritten, with localized grammar and notation corrections and a project-lead author footnote. Section order is retained. Section 3.2 introduces an incorrect Figure 3 architecture reference in place of Figure 2.

P2.justification: Figure 2 is restyled with adjusted boxes and labels, colored reward outlines, revised illustrative values and a corrected flame/snowflake legend. Text and figures undergo limited reflow, bringing the conclusion entirely onto page 8. The remaining figure and table content and structures are retained.

improvement.justification: The clearer abstract, more consistent feature/score notation and corrected Figure 2 legend provide modest improvements in readability and technical clarity. The planned code address adds useful access information, while experimental evidence remains unchanged. These gains outweigh the limited regression from the incorrect Figure 3 pointer in Section 3.2.
